caption: The drawing features a single metallic object positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object resembles a bell with a broad, flared lower section that splits into three distinct, curved panels, giving it a skirt-like appearance. Attached to the top of this section is a rounded knob, from which a triangular, arched handle extends upward, curving smoothly and attaching at two points on either side of the knob. The metallic object is rendered in dark brown and black hues, with subtle highlights and shading to indicate its reflective surface and curvature. The artist's signature, "Thomas Dooley 1939," appears in small text at the lower left corner of the drawing. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Six Bladed Food Chopper
